seo.title: Amenities | Rooftop, Fitness & Co-working at Maison Aster
seo.description: Maison Aster residents get eight shared spaces with no amenity fees: rooftop terrace, 24/7 fitness studio, co-working, yoga room, pet spa and resident lounge.

hero.title: Amenities
hero.subline: Eight shared spaces, from the rooftop to the pet spa. All included.

summary: Residents of Maison Aster get eight shared spaces at no extra cost, including a rooftop terrace, a 24/7 fitness studio, co-working and a pet spa.

mosaic.label: (What’s included)
mosaic.heading: No amenity fees. Every space is designed to be used every day, not just shown on a tour.

services.label: (Also included)
services.heading: The details you notice on day 300, not just day one.

items.title: On-site team
items.body: Leasing and management in the building, seven days a week.

items.title: 24/7 maintenance
items.body: Emergency response any time, plus online requests.

items.title: Smart parcel room
items.body: Lockers with cold storage for groceries.

items.title: Bike storage
items.body: Secure racks and a repair station on P1.

items.title: EV charging
items.body: Level 2 chargers in the underground garage.

items.title: Resident app
items.body: Book spaces, pay rent and message the team.

items.title: Keyless entry
items.body: One fob for your suite, the lobby and amenities.

items.title: Guest suite
items.body: Bookable for visiting family and friends.
